summary: UART initialization hang in firmware bootloader on STM32H7
description:
The bootloader hangs during UART initialization on the STM32H7 when the USART3 peripheral clock is not properly enabled before configuring the baud rate register. The hang occurs in uart_init() which writes to USART_BRR before enabling the USART clock in RCC_APB1ENR1.

Expected flow:
  1. Enable USART3 clock via RCC
  2. Configure GPIO pins for AF7
  3. Set baud rate in BRR
  4. Enable USART

Actual flow:
  1. Configure GPIO (works)
  2. Set BRR (hangs — bus fault because clock not enabled)

This is a firmware-level issue in the bare-metal bootloader code.
